projects.title: SnakeGame
projects.summary: Terminal input/output puzzle game that prints a board, collects coordinate inputs, and runs the board simulation.
projects.notes: Queue each input value in order (x, y, slash type, repeat), then run the script in-browser.

projects.title: Hangman
projects.summary: Terminal word-guessing game with difficulty selection, repeated guesses, and ASCII hangman board updates.
projects.notes: Runs in the same in-browser terminal flow as SnakeGame. If no OpenAI key is present, the script falls back to its local word bank.

projects.title: GymDataParsing
projects.summary: Interactive terminal script that parses messy workout-note text into a pandas DataFrame, then runs a simple exercise query to preview results.
projects.notes: Prompts for Enter-through steps, previews parsed data, and offers a 1/2/3 query choice in the same in-browser terminal flow.
